_doc: Her episodes (docs/PET_EPISODES_PLAN.md), read by brain.gd: little stories with a cause, an effect and several endings.
weight: how much she likes it (plus mood: {feeling: amount}). cool: seconds before it can happen again. needs: clips it can't do without. night / day: only then.
beats, in order. go: corner | near | far | front | spot, with walk: a walk style (walk_tiptoe_, walk_hands_, ...).
play: a clip or prefix, or a list of them (the first she has: the new take before its stand-in). for: seconds, or end: true (to the clip's end). quick: a faster blend (a startle).
with mood (and mood_w), emote, look: ground | thing | front.
thing: a kind (things.gd) appearing on the floor at: metres in front of her. thing_do: crawl (to: her) | wander | flee | fly_off | hand | hop_at.
branch: [[weight, [beats...]], ...]: one ending, picked when the episode starts.
